substeps.caption: Four polished coupons under O-ring lids, face up on pogo pins (DAL PR #180's plan). The P20 on the CubXL's head takes a tip.
It fills well S1 with 150 uL of 0.6 M NaCl (3.5 wt%) from its stock vial, which the capper uncaps and caps again. The O-ring leaves 3 mm of the coupon wet: 0.071 cm2.
Tip off. The capper's magnet picks up the electrode cap: a leak-free 2 mm Ag/AgCl reference inside a coil of Pt wire, the counter.
The cap goes on S1. Its pogo pins land on the RE and CE pads; the coupon's back is on the WE pin. The head is free.
The EZstat Pro beside the deck holds the cell at open circuit for 30 min: OCP settles to E_corr.
LPR, then a cyclic polarization at 1 mV/s: up from 50 mV below OCP, reversing at 1 mA/cm2, back to E_corr. 44 min a spot at 1 mV/s.
The capper lifts the cap off, dips it in the rinse cup and parks it.
A fresh tip takes the well's liquid to tube 1, for ICP: dissolved Al and Mg, element by element.
On to S2. At 44 min a spot, a 12 h night screens 16 spots; at the G61 rate, 6.
